title: Cancelling a Scheduled Mold Remediation Job
content:
The job must be in scheduled status when it is cancelled. A customer may cancel a scheduled Mold Remediation job before signing the remediation agreement. The late cancellation fee applies only when the cancellation comes later than the notice deadline before the scheduled start date. The notice deadline is the scheduled start date minus the tier's cancellation notice days, counted in calendar days; a cancellation on the deadline date itself is in time and carries no fee. Warranty jobs never carry a cancellation fee.

## How the deadline is read

- **Clock starts from**: the job's scheduled start date on the company's records.
- **Counting**: count back the tier's cancellation notice days in calendar days from the scheduled start date; the date reached is the notice deadline.
- **Comparison**: the cancellation date recorded on the job against the notice deadline. On or before the deadline: in time, no fee. Later than the deadline: the late cancellation fee applies.
- **Warranty jobs**: no cancellation fee in any case.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

A Standard Mold Remediation job, cancellation notice 3 calendar days, scheduled to start on 14 March:

| Cancellation date | Position | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March | Before the deadline | None |
| 11 March | On the deadline | None |
| 12 March | After the deadline | Late cancellation fee |

An Extensive Mold Remediation job with a scheduled start of 20 September has a notice deadline of 15 September; a cancellation on 16 September carries the tier's late cancellation fee.
